name: WWT London Wetland Centre Play Areas
description: Explore Adventure Play Area with a zip line, bouncy lily pads, a climbing frame and trail course, plus a Splash Pad with a water tunnel, fountains and puddles (closed in winter), a mud kitchen and the Wild Walk with balance beams and bridges. Gated areas for younger children.
fee: Non-members pay to visit; see the centre's tickets page for prices. WWT members get in free at all 10 wetland centres.
